LEFT JOIN tech_assemble d ON a.product_id =d.id

ta.weight * a.inspection_quantity complete_net_weight,
CASE mbp.wage_quota_type WHEN 1 THEN ta.net_weight * a.inspection_quantity/1000 WHEN 2 THEN ta.length * a.inspection_quantity/1000 ELSE ta.length * a.inspection_quantity/1000 END
CASE mbp.wage_quota_type WHEN 1 THEN ta.net_weight * a.inspection_quantity/1000 WHEN 2 THEN ta.length * a.inspection_quantity/1000 ELSE ta.surface_area*a.inspection_quantity/1000/1000 END
CASE mbp.wage_quota_type WHEN 1 THEN ta.weight * a.inspection_quantity/1000 WHEN 2 THEN ta.length * a.inspection_quantity/1000 ELSE ta.length*ta.width*a.inspection_quantity/1000/1000 END
ta.length * a.inspection_quantity/1000

WHEN 1 THEN product.net_weight*a.quantity WHEN 2 THEN product.length*a.quantity WHEN 4 THEN product.surface_area*a.quantity ELSE a.quantity END

SELECT report.task_process_id id, report.create_time, report.number, product.serial_number, c.user_name teamLeaderName FROM `mes_building_produce_team_report` report LEFT JOIN tech_artifact product ON report.product_id = product.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link c ON report.team_id = c.team_id AND c.bool_leader_enum = 1 AND c.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE task_process_id = #{previousTaskProcessId} AND report.bool_delete_enum = 0

select mr.id, mr.number, mr.process_id, wr.status, b.name from mes_building_produce_team_report mr LEFT JOIN mes_building_warehouse_record wr on wr.product_id = mr.product_id and mr.number = wr.number and wr.type = 1 and wr.product_type = #{taskTypeEnum} and area_id = #{areaId} and wr.bool_delete_enum=0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_process b on b.id = mr.process_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_process process on process.id = mr.task_process_id where mr.id in (select min(a.id) from mes_building_produce_team_report a where a.product_id = #{productId} and a.task_id = #{taskId} and a.task_type_enum = #{taskTypeEnum} and a.inspection_quantity = 1 and a.bool_delete_enum = 0 GROUP BY a.number) and process.sequence = 0 order by mr.number asc

SELECT DISTINCT report.process_id 'process.id', process.`name` 'process.name', production_line.id 'productionLine.id', production_line.`name` 'productionLine.name', report.groups_id 'groups.id', gro.`name` 'groups.name', users.id 'user.id', users.`name` 'user.name', sum(report.quantity) quantity, process.sort
,report.create_time date
FROM mes_building_produce_team_report report LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_process task_process ON report.task_process_id = task_process.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line production_line ON production_line.id = task_process.production_line_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON process.id = report.process_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_groups gro ON gro.id=report.groups_id LEFT JOIN sys_user users ON users.id = report.user_id WHERE report.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND report.product_id = #{productId} AND report.task_type_enum = 2
AND report.number=#{number}
AND report.task_id= #{taskId}
GROUP BY report.process_id, production_line.id, report.groups_id, users.id
,report.create_time

SELECT DISTINCT report.process_id 'process.id', process.`name` 'process.name', production_line.id 'productionLine.id', production_line.`name` 'productionLine.name', report.groups_id 'groups.id', users.id 'user.id', users.`name` 'user.name', sum(report.quantity) quantity, process.sort
,report.create_time date
FROM mes_building_produce_team_report report LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_process task_process ON report.task_process_id = task_process.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line production_line ON production_line.id = task_process.production_line_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process process ON process.id = report.process_id LEFT JOIN sys_user users ON users.id = report.user_id WHERE report.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND report.product_id = #{productId} AND report.task_type_enum = 16
AND report.number=#{number}
AND report.task_id= #{taskId}
GROUP BY report.process_id, production_line.id, report.groups_id, users.id
,report.create_time

SELECT `month`, SUM(mete) mete FROM ( SELECT `month`, task_id, MIN(mete) mete FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(report.create_time,"%Y-%m") MONTH, report.task_id, report.quantity * artifact.net_weight mete FROM mes_building_produce_team_report report LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON report.product_id = artifact.id WHERE task_type_enum = 2
AND artifact.project_id= #{projectId}
AND DATE_FORMAT(report.create_time, "%Y")=DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, "%Y")
AND process_id IN ( SELECT id FROM mes_building_process WHERE product_type = 2 AND type = #{processTypeEnum})) a GROUP BY `month`, task_id ) a GROUP BY `month`

SELECT `month` as dateTime, SUM(mete) mete FROM ( SELECT `month`, task_id, MIN(mete) mete FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(report.create_time,"%Y-%m") MONTH, report.task_id, report.quantity * artifact.net_weight mete FROM mes_building_produce_team_report report LEFT JOIN tech_artifact artifact ON report.product_id = artifact.id and artifact.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line as line ON line.id = report.production_line_id and line.bool_delete_enum = FALSE LEFT JOIN contract_project as cp on cp.id = artifact.project_id and cp.bool_delete_enum = FALSE WHERE task_type_enum = 2 and report.bool_delete_enum = FALSE
AND DATE_FORMAT(report.create_time, "%Y")=DATE_FORMAT(#{dateTime}, "%Y")
AND EXISTS( select 1 from project_branch_company_link pbcl where pbcl.bool_delete_enum = FALSE AND pbcl.branch_company_level = 2 and pbcl.branch_company_id = #{branchCompanyId} and pbcl.project_id = cp.id )
AND line.workshop_id = #{workshopId}
AND process_id IN ( SELECT id FROM mes_building_process WHERE product_type = 2 AND type = #{processTypeEnum})) a GROUP BY `month`, task_id ) a GROUP BY `month`

SELECT sum(a.inspection_quantity) groupKey, sum( a.inspection_quantity * mba.net_weight ) mete FROM mes_building_produce_inspection_team_report a
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part mba ON a.product_id =mba.id AND mba.bool_delete_enum=FALSE
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact mba ON a.product_id =mba.id AND mba.bool_delete_enum=FALSE

LEFT JOIN tech_assemble mba ON a.product_id =mba.id AND mba.bool_delete_enum=FALSE
a.bool_delete_enum=FALSE
AND a.in_year_month_day_date >= date_format(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
AND a.in_year_month_day_date <= date_format(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and a.user_id = #{userId}
and a.task_type_enum & #{taskTypeEnum}>0

SELECT sum(a.inspection_quantity) groupKey, sum(a.inspection_quantity*mba.net_weight) mete FROM mes_building_produce_team_report a LEFT JOIN mes_building_task task ON a.task_id = task.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_process mbp ON mbp.id = a.process_id LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part mba ON a.product_id =mba.id AND mba.bool_delete_enum=FALSE
a.bool_delete_enum=FALSE
AND date(a.create_time) >=date(#{startDate})
AND date(a.create_time) <=date(#{endDate})
AND a.task_type_enum =#{taskTypeEnum}
AND mbp.type = 8
AND task.nest_cut_plate_id = #{cutId}

SELECT report.productId 'productId' , report.reprotQuantity 'reprotQuantity' , report.inspectionQuantity 'inspectionQuantity', report.report_time 'reportTime', report.report_number 'reportNumberId', report.task_process_id 'taskProcessId', report.task_type_enum, report.team_id 'team.id', report.report_type, report.user_id, pro.id 'project.id', pro.`name` 'project.name', pro.short_name 'project.short_name', pro.serial_number 'project.serial_number', mon.id 'monomer.id', mon.`name` 'monomer.name', area.id 'area.id', area.`name` 'area.name', user.id 'user.id', user.name 'user.name', mba.serial_number 'serialNumber', task.bool_one_code 'booleOneCode', workshop.id 'workshop.id', workshop.`name` 'workshop.name', line.id 'productionLine.id', line.`name` 'productionLine.name' FROM ( SELECT a.task_id, a.task_process_id, a.product_id productId, a.task_type_enum, a.team_id, a.user_id, a.report_time, a.report_number, a.report_type, a.workshop_id, a.production_line_id, SUM( a.quantity ) reprotQuantity, SUM( a.inspection_quantity + a.problem_quantity ) inspectionQuantity FROM mes_building_produce_team_report a LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_process process ON a.task_process_id = process.id WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE and a.inspection_quantity + a.problem_quantity=0
and
( a.task_process_id= #{dto.taskProcessId} and a.team_id=#{dto.teamId})
AND a.task_type_enum &#{taskTypeEnum}
GROUP BY a.task_id, a.task_process_id, a.product_id, a.task_type_enum, a.team_id, a.user_id, a.report_time, a.report_number, a.report_type, a.workshop_id, a.production_line_id ) report LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_process process ON report.task_process_id = process.id AND process.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_task task ON report.task_id = task.id AND task.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN contract_project pro ON process.project_id = pro.id AND pro.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN plan_monomer mon ON mon.id = process.monomer_id AND mon.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN plan_area area ON process.area_id = area.id AND area.bool_delete_enum = 0
LEFT JOIN tech_machine_part mba ON report.productId =mba.id AND mba.bool_delete_enum=FALSE
LEFT JOIN tech_artifact mba ON report.productId =mba.id AND mba.bool_delete_enum=FALSE
LEFT JOIN tech_enclosure mba ON report.productId =mba.id AND mba.bool_delete_enum=FALSE
LEFT JOIN tech_assemble mba ON report.productId =mba.id AND mba.bool_delete_enum=FALSE
LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop workshop ON workshop.id = report.workshop_id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line line ON line.id = report.production_line_id LEFT JOIN sys_user user ON user.id = report.user_id order by report.report_number asc

select task_process_id, groups_id groupId, team_id, user_id, report_time, number, report_number reportNumberId , quantity quantity, inspection_quantity inspectionQuantity, problem_quantity problemQuantity from mes_building_produce_team_report where
( task_process_id= #{recNumer.taskProcessId} and groups_id=#{recNumer.groupId} and team_id=#{recNumer.teamId} and report_number=#{recNumer.reportNumberId} and user_id=#{recNumer.userId})

select IFNULL(SUM(report.inspection_quantity),0) from mes_building_produce_team_report report left join mes_building_team_user_link link on link.team_id = report.team_id where report.bool_delete_enum = 0 and link.bool_delete_enum = 0 and report.process_id = #{processId} and link.user_id = #{userId} and report.in_year_month_date = DATE_FORMAT(now(), '%Y%-%m')

select count(distinct project_id) from mes_building_task_process proc left join mes_building_team team on proc.team_id = team.id left join mes_building_team_user_link tulink on tulink.team_id = team.id where proc.bool_delete_enum =0 and tulink.bool_delete_enum = 0 and team.bool_delete_enum = 0 and proc.process_id = #{processId} and tulink.user_id = #{userId}

select IFNULL(sum(need_quantity - inspection_quantity),0) from mes_building_task_process proc left join mes_building_team team on proc.team_id = team.id left join mes_building_team_user_link tulink on tulink.team_id = team.id where proc.bool_delete_enum =0 and tulink.bool_delete_enum = 0 and team.bool_delete_enum = 0 and proc.process_id = #{processId} and tulink.user_id = #{userId}

select IFNULL(sum(ass.quantity - ass.produce_quantity), 0) from mes_building_assist ass left join mes_building_task_process proc on ass.task_process_id = proc.id left join mes_building_team team on proc.team_id = team.id left join mes_building_team_user_link tulink on tulink.team_id = team.id where proc.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tulink.bool_delete_enum = 0 and team.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND ass.quantity != ass.produce_quantity and proc.process_id = #{processId} and tulink.user_id = #{userId}

select IFNULL(SUM(report.inspection_quantity),0) from mes_building_produce_team_report report left join mes_building_team_user_link link on link.team_id = report.team_id where report.bool_delete_enum = 0 and link.bool_delete_enum = 0 and report.process_id = #{processId} and link.user_id = #{userId} and YEAR(report.create_time) = YEAR(CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND MONTH(report.create_time) = MONTH(CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND DAY(report.create_time) = DAY(CURDATE() - INTERVAL 1 DAY);

select IFNULL(SUM(report.inspection_quantity),0) from mes_building_produce_team_report report left join mes_building_team_user_link link on link.team_id = report.team_id where report.bool_delete_enum = 0 and link.bool_delete_enum = 0 and report.process_id = #{processId} and link.user_id = #{userId} AND report.in_year_month_day_date = DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-%d')

select calendar.date_sequence as date, IFNULL(SUM(quantity), 0) as quantity from (SELECT MAKEDATE(#{year}, 1) + INTERVAL seq MONTH AS date_sequence FROM (SELECT @seq := @seq + 1 AS seq FROM information_schema.columns, (SELECT @seq := -1) tmp LIMIT 12) months) calendar left join mes_building_produce_team_report report ON DATE_FORMAT(report.create_time, '%Y-%m') = DATE_FORMAT(calendar.date_sequence, '%Y-%m') and report.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join mes_building_team_user_link link on link.team_id = report.team_id and link.bool_delete_enum = 0 where (YEAR(report.create_time) = #{year} or report.create_time is null) AND (link.user_id = #{userId} OR link.user_id IS NULL) AND (report.process_id = #{processId} or report.process_id is null ) group by calendar.date_sequence

select report.*, task.project_id 'projectId', task.monomer_id 'monomerId', task.area_id 'areaId', orde.order_number 'orderNumber', line.name 'prodLineName', team.id 'teamId', link.user_name 'teamLeaderName' from mes_building_produce_team_report report LEFT JOIN mes_building_task task ON report.task_id = task.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_task_order orde on task.task_order_id = orde.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line line on report.production_line_id = line.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team team ON report.team_id = team.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_team_user_link link ON team.id = link.team_id WHERE report.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND task.bool_delete_enum = 0 and team.bool_delete_enum = 0 and link.bool_delete_enum = 0 and link.bool_leader_enum = 1 and report.id = #{id}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM mes_building_produce_team_report WHERE team_id = #{teamId}) AS result;

SELECT t1.report_time as 'lastProcessTime', t1.number as number, pro.`name` as 'lastProcessName', user.`name` as 'reportUserName' FROM mes_building_produce_team_report t1 JOIN ( SELECT task_id, number, MAX(report_time) as max_report_time FROM mes_building_produce_team_report WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0
and
task_id = #{key} and number in
#{number}
GROUP BY task_id, number ) t2 ON t1.task_id = t2.task_id AND t1.number = t2.number AND t1.report_time = t2.max_report_time left join mes_building_process pro on t1.process_id = pro.id and pro.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join mes_building_team_user_link tulink on t1.team_id = tulink.team_id and tulink.bool_delete_enum = 0 and tulink.bool_leader_enum = 1 left join sys_user user on tulink.user_id = user.id and user.bool_delete_enum = 0 where t1.bool_delete_enum = 0

SELECT t1.report_time as 'lastProcessTime', pro.`name` as 'lastProcessName', usr.`name` as 'reportUserName', sum(t1.quantity) reportQuantity FROM mes_building_produce_team_report t1 JOIN ( SELECT task_id, number, MAX(report_time) as max_report_time FROM mes_building_produce_team_report WHERE bool_delete_enum = 0
and
task_id = #{key} and number in
